entry.title: Preview: Extended Markdown formatting for agent messages
entry.summary:
Agents can now send richer, better-formatted responses using extended Markdown formatting (currently in preview), supporting tables, task lists, code blocks, equations, images, at-mentions, and citations. Extended Markdown content renders progressively during streaming.

For more information, see the announcement.
